name: market-terminal-webui
description: Web UI projection of the Pi market-terminal extension — extension logic runs unchanged.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.verify-extension-unchanged: diff -q .pi/extensions/market-terminal.ts ../unbrowser-fin-terminal/.pi/extensions/market-terminal.ts && echo 'extension byte-identical to source worktree' || (echo 'EXTENSION MODIFIED — must stay unchanged' && exit 1)
